title: Pipeline / tool
description: A named, pinned piece of software that produced something in this registry: a quantizer, a logits capturer, a KLD scorer, an aggregator, or a panel builder. Measurements name the stack that measured them; artifacts may name the stack that built them.

repository.description: Repo URL or HF repo id. null only for closed/unknown third-party stacks.

runtime_reader_sha256.description: For packed-format readers: the ABI/reader identity our receipts seal.

dependencies.description: Pinned versions that materially affect numerics, e.g. torch, vllm, exllamav3, flash-attn.

lane.description: Which MEASUREMENT LANE this stack is. Lanes are NOT interchangeable: submission.schema.json's `lane` enum names them, and a number from a non-sealed lane carries an offset against the sealed lane on the same panel. Declaring the lane here is what lets a row say which lane produced it without a human choosing; `bridge` is where that offset stops being an adjective and becomes a measured number.

expert_parallel_emulated.description: true when the lane reproduces an expert-parallel partition inside one process instead of across real ranks.

reduce_order.description: The routed-expert combine order/precision this lane used, verbatim as the runner names it (e.g. fp32, sequential, reverse, pairwise). This is the op that differs between lanes; naming it is the difference between a disclosed offset and an unexplained one.

bridge.description: The MEASURED relation between this lane and the sealed lane, on one named panel, for one named pair of measurements. Never an estimate: every field here is read off a verdict receipt that scored both surfaces.

delta_mean_kld.description: this lane's mean minus the sealed lane's mean, in nats. Signed.

tokenwise_kld_sha256_matches_sealed.description: false means this lane produced a DIFFERENT tokenwise array, however close the mean. A lane that cannot reproduce the array is not a reproduction of the sealed run.

publishable_as_reproduction.description: The runner's own verdict on whether this lane's output may be published as a reproduction of the sealed number. false is the honest answer for a lane whose combine order differs.

verdict.description: The verdict receipt's own verdict string, verbatim.

evidence.description: The verdict receipt(s) these numbers were read from.

cost.description: Optional, and the one place this registry touches local-ai-registry's territory: what one measurement costs to reproduce.
